title: Circuit to CNF map
statement: Given a Boolean list, decode it as a DAG circuit. If decoding succeeds and every gate has fan-in two, return the circuit's CNF; if decoding fails or some gate does not have fan-in two, return the CNF consisting of the single empty clause.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the circuit's fan-in condition or its conversion to CNF.
